items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Ella Fitzgerald, one of the greatest of all time, and I got to play with her. I subbed in Buddy Morrow’s band.

ctx.x: Good statement. How did the business change during the war years?

Well when the band thing was over, you know, I caught some of the good part of it. When the business changed they went into vocalists, which was great, because the vocalist still accompanied the bands. You know, Ella Fitzgerald, one of the greatest of all time, and I got to play with her. I subbed in Buddy Morrow’s band. And I took the gig, I had three days off, because I loved the way Buddy played trombone and I wanted to hear her sing. So I played for three days. The business changed I think, and due respect,…
